sections.heading: Pricing caveats
sections.body: Verified 2026-08-17 from learnworlds.com/pricing/. Monthly vs annually (save ~20%). Starter $29/mo ($24/mo billed annually) with $5 per paid enrollment; Pro Trainer $99/mo ($79 annual) no enrollment fees; Learning Center $299/mo ($249 annual) no enrollment fees; Corporate custom. Starter: 1,000 active learners/mo, 1 admin, 300 AI credits. Pro Trainer: 2,000 learners, 5 admins, 500 AI credits. Learning Center: 2,000 learners, 25 admins, 1,000 AI credits, white-label, up to 10 client groups. 30-day trial with core features. Prices exclude VAT.
